newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mubarak to meet Chirac in Paris Monday.
newsitem.headline: Mubarak to meet Chirac in Paris Monday.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak will visit Paris on Monday for talks on the Middle East peace process with French President Jacques Chirac, Chirac's office said on Tuesday.
Mubarak will visit France after attending the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, at the weekend. The two leaders will meet at Chirac's Elysee Palace at 3.30 p.m. (1430 GMT).
Chirac's spokeswoman Catherine Colonna said the meeting would give the two leaders a chance to discuss the Middle East after last week's Israeli pullout from most of the West Bank city of Hebron.
